data.title: Paramount Skydance (NASDAQ:PSKY) Stock Slides After FCC Approves 49.5% Foreign Ownership Stake
data.description:
Entertainment giant Paramount Skydance (PSKY) may soon be nearly half foreign-owned, if the merger between itself and Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD) concludes successfully. The Federal Communications Commission (FCC) recently approved Paramount's own petition to be 49.5% owned by foreign entities. This did not sit well with investors, meanwhile, who sent Paramount shares down over 3% in the closing minutes of Thursday's trading. Paramount has seen a 43.87% loss in its share price over the past year.

Mother May I?

The biggest issue here was that Paramount owns 28 television stations. This requires the FCC to step in and approve a request for foreign entities to own anything more than 25% of the operation. And given that Paramount's move to acquire Warner is supported by the sovereign wealth funds of three different Gulf State entities, that meant a lot more than 25% was going to be owned by those funds.

The FCC noted that it was "…persuaded by Paramount's argument that the Foreign Investors therefore will not be able to wield any influence, let alone control, over decisions involving the Licensees." Given that 100% of voting stock will be held by the Ellison family and RedBird Capital Partners, this limited the foreign ownership stake to more of a silent partner position. Concern about the deal, of course, still emerged regardless of the FCC's stance.

What About the Indies?

Independent film has not been taking the move to streaming well. While once, the presence of video stores ensured sales of physical discs for a wide range of independent film titles, the rise of the streaming market has not done so well for the indie market. Some believe that indies will continue to suffer under a merged Paramount and Warner.

AGC chairman and CEO Stuart Ford penned a column for Deadline, noted that the independent film sector seems to be a non-starter in the Warner/Paramount deal altogether. Much of the complaint is focused on theater chains, streaming companies, and cable distributors. Indie film's presence in those complaints is nowhere to be seen, Ford asserted.

data.title: Apple Stock (AAPL): iPhone Survey Points to 28% Higher Average Selling Price
data.description:
Tech giant Apple (AAPL) could be heading into a stronger-than-usual iPhone upgrade cycle, according to Evercore ISI's latest consumer survey. The investment firm surveyed nearly 4,000 people and found that the expected average selling price, or ASP, reached $1,374. That is nearly 28% higher and well above Evercore's long-term survey average. Five-star analyst Amit Daryanani, who is ranked #14 out of 12,512 Wall Street analysts, also believes that iPhone pricing could rise more than 20% due to higher prices and greater demand for expensive models with more memory.

In fact, 53% of respondents said they plan to buy an iPhone 18 Pro or Pro Max. Evercore's historical average is 51%.

The Pro Max showed an even bigger move toward premium models. About 32% of consumers said they plan to buy the Pro Max, compared with 29% in last year's survey.

Apple's new iPhone Duo also appears to be attracting interest. About 14% of respondents said they plan to buy one. Last year, only 9% said they intended to buy the then-new iPhone Air.

More Apple Users Are Planning to Upgrade

Separately, the survey suggests that more existing users are ready to replace their phones. About 61% of respondents said that they plan to purchase an iPhone this year. That is up from 59% last year and is actually the second-highest reading in Evercore's survey history. It is also far above the firm's long-term average of 45%.

That stronger upgrade interest is worth noting because Apple could benefit from both higher unit demand and higher prices at the same time. If more buyers choose Pro models or larger memory configurations, revenue could rise faster than unit sales alone would suggest. The survey also found a small increase in consumers who plan to upgrade their Apple Watch and AirPods.

Therefore, Evercore sees the potential for Apple to surprise to the upside compared to Wall Street revenue expectations for Fiscal 2027, which sit near 7% growth. Daryanani also kept his Buy rating and raised his Apple price target to $380 from $365.

data.title: Ford Stock (NYSE:F) Slides as Washington Steps Up Rhetoric Around Chinese Partnerships
data.description:
It was just two weeks ago that the Secretary of Transportation, Sean Duffy, referred to legacy automaker Ford (F) and its Chinese partnerships as a cause for "profound concern." But now, the rhetoric has stepped up a notch, with the phrase "national security problem" recently emerging. That left investors very concerned, and Ford shares lost nearly 4% in Friday afternoon's trading. Ford has also seen a 17.13% rally in its share price over the past year.

That Concern Just Gets Stronger

Ford was able to push back on the commentary thanks in large part to the nature of the partnership between Ford and the Contemporary Amperex Technology Co. Limited (SCTATF), also known as CATL. Ford owns the Marshall, Michigan plant where the batteries are produced, runs its operations, and pays for the workforce therein, that produces batteries originally made by CATL. Other companies simply import the batteries outright.

But even as Ford can be clear that the nature of its involvement with China is comparatively limited and helps United States battery manufacturing, the fact that CATL has deep connections to the Chinese military could be a problem. Ford may have few options but to drop the CATL connection and develop its own technology at great and not immediately recoverable expense.

Moving Mountains, or Just Batteries

A new report from Inside EVs took a look at the battery in a Ford F-150 Lightning, and how easy it was to replace. There was good news and bad news to the report. The good news is that, in some ways, it was easier than swapping the engine out of a gas-powered car. This is somewhat limited in terms of how "good" the news actually is, because pulling an engine from a car is perhaps the most difficult and complex of car maintenance moves.

The bad news, however, is that in some respects, it is apparently even harder. Disconnecting the battery was perhaps the easiest part. But pulling the battery itself—which weighs 1,800 pounds—was a far more difficult process. For reference, a typical V8 engine weighs between 400 and 700 pounds.

data.title: Meta's Muse Passes ChatGPT to Become No. 1 App in U.S. App Store
data.description:
Muse AI, the new AI agent from social media giant Meta Platforms (META), has reached the top of Apple's (AAPL) U.S. App Store just over one week after its launch. Muse now ranks number one overall, ahead of AI developer OpenAI's ChatGPT at number two. In addition, Google's (GOOGL) Gemini ranks eighth, while Anthropic's Claude sits at number 13. The strong start gives Meta an important win as it tries to compete with other companies that already have millions of people using their AI assistants.

One reason Muse stands out is that it can do more than answer questions. For example, Muse can send emails or book trips. It can also open a web browser and fill out forms. Meta says it can even negotiate for users in certain situations.

The process starts when a user gives Muse a goal. From there, the app can create a personalized plan and organize the steps needed to complete it. Muse can then continue the work on its own, even after the user closes the app. If a task requires permission, Muse can stop and ask the user before taking the next step.

Muse Is Already Ahead of Several Major AI Rivals

Importantly, the App Store rankings show how quickly Muse has caught people's attention. This means that Muse has already moved ahead of several well-known AI products despite launching only recently.

Meta Chief AI Officer Alexander Wang celebrated this achievement on X and said that the company has been excited to see what people are already doing with Muse.

The early success also gives Meta a new way to put its AI directly in front of consumers. Until now, much of Meta's AI strategy has been dependent on apps such as Facebook and Instagram. Muse is different because it is a standalone product that competes directly with ChatGPT and Gemini.

data.title: Intel Stock (NASDAQ:INTC) Slips Despite SK Hynix Response on Intel Deal
data.description:
What a difference two days makes. We only recently heard about a possible deal brewing between chip stock Intel (INTC) and chip maker SK Hynix (SKHY). But SK Hynix recently responded to that deal, noting that there was no deal at all between the two. Or at least, no deal has been established yet, which is in line with the reports we heard from two days ago. Investors were disheartened, though, and gave Intel stock a nearly 2% loss in Friday afternoon's trading. Intel has seen a 267.82% rally in its share price over the past year.

No Deal, Yet

SK Hynix, a report from Techzine noted, has denied that any plans are confirmed. This is reasonable enough, as the reports that there even were plans at all emerged just two days ago. The statement that SK Hynix released noted that it was "…exploring various options to strengthen its global competitiveness."

This is reasonable enough, and given that the early word around the plans focused on the Ohio plant—which has still not been built just yet—the idea that the plans would take a while to coalesce, let alone start, was not out of line. The Ohio plant was originally supposed to start production this year, but new reports push that back to 2030.

AutoSR to Hit Panther Lake Chips

Meanwhile, the Panther Lake lineup is set to get a bit of a boost. Microsoft (MSFT) will be offering support for the Automatic Super Resolution (AutoSR) function on Panther Lake. AutoSR is a comparatively new system, released back in 2024, and allows systems access to resolution upscaling where it was not available before.

Results with AutoSR have been impressive, though. Using Assassin's Creed: Valhalla as a benchmark, testing done at TechPowerUp got 1600p resolution with "High" in-game settings got the frame rate increased from 45 FPS to 52 FPS. AutoSR hopes to get that number to 60, which will certainly be helpful for games and other applications that support no other form of upscaling.

data.title: Coinbase Stock (COIN) Soars 12% as Baird Says SEC Exemption Puts Offerings 'More on Par' with Robinhood's
data.description:
Shares in U.S. crypto exchange Coinbase (COIN) continued their rally on Friday afternoon, jumping 12% to around $194. This came as crypto stocks rallied following a new exemption from the U.S. securities watchdog. The new policy now allows trading in tokenized U.S. stocks. COIN also jumped after Robert W. Baird analyst Robert Bamberger noted that the exemption puts Coinbase's asset-class offerings "more on par" with those of brokerage Robinhood (HOOD).

Baird Says SEC Exemption Is 'a Positive' for Coinbase

On Wednesday, the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) issued the "Innovation Exemption." The exemption allows platforms to trade certain tokenized U.S. stocks on blockchains for five years.

The agency said the goal is to enable innovation while it considers broader regulation for on-chain trading. Paul Atkins, SEC's chair, noted that the exemption will help to "bring America's capital markets into the digital age."

In response, Bamberger noted that the exemption is "a positive for Coinbase, particularly with CLARITY Act delays." On September 15, the U.S. Senate failed to advance the key crypto legislation. This came as the Act failed to secure the required number of votes to move forward.

Why Baird Remains on the Sidelines on Coinbase Stock

Despite the bullish comments, Bamberger maintained his Hold rating on Coinbase shares. He also kept his price target at $130, representing about 34% downside.

Yet, the analyst noted that he is more positive on Coinbase than before. This is due to three factors:

  • Coinbase is seeing a rebound in volume. In other words, more people are trading on the crypto exchange's platform
  • Regulatory trends affecting the industry are becoming more favorable
  • Coinbase continues to develop its "Everything Exchange" strategy. Under the strategy, the exchange is expanding beyond crypto trading.

data.title: U.S. Automakers Call on Trump to Maintain Ban on Chinese Vehicles: GM, F, STLA
data.description:
The U.S. automotive industry is calling on U.S. President Donald Trump to maintain policies that make it difficult for Chinese automakers to operate in and sell their vehicles within the American market. In a letter to Trump, lobby groups representing major U.S. automakers such as General Motors (GM), Ford (F), and Stellantis (STLA) urged the president to "maintain policies that keep the door firmly shut to Chinese automakers seeking to sell, import or manufacture vehicles inside the U.S."

"The automotive sector is foundational to our advanced manufacturing and defense base, with the capacity and workforce to respond during a national emergency. Once that base is hollowed out, it can't be rebuilt overnight," reads the letter. Currently, the U.S. imposes a steep 100% tariff on Chinese electric vehicle imports and heavy duties on other Chinese auto imports to protect domestic manufacturing.

The steep tariffs have meant that Chinese autos are effectively barred from the U.S. market.
